text.text: We use your personal data for your benefit. We never sell it.
When we answer queries submitted through our contact forms, chat, e-mail or social media.
When we keep you posted on company updates through emails and newsletters.
When we build targeted audiences for social media campaigns to ensure the relevancy of our communications.
Also we optimize Google & social media ads based on collected anonymized data.
We need understand your current experience with our website in order to improve it.
We create statistics around website traffic, marketing performance, communication initiatives.
